direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: mada 0.5.12 is the statistical authority for the count-based Reitsma bivariate model.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: meta

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: svglite
evidence: r/RCMetaR/R/plot_devices.R: rcmetar.open.svg_device renders canonical forest plot SVG files with svglite::svglite(...)
direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Forest plot exports use svglite as the canonical vector rendering device so all output formats share one source artifact.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: rsvg
evidence: r/RCMetaR/R/plot_devices.R: rcmetar.export.svg_render converts canonical SVG files to PNG, PDF, and bitmap exports with rsvg
direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Forest plot PNG, PDF, and TIFF exports are derived from canonical SVG output through librsvg-backed conversion.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: png
evidence: r/RCMetaR/R/plot_devices.R: png::readPNG(..., native=TRUE) supplies packed raster data to the TIFF device
direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Publication TIFF export avoids large floating-point raster and channel copies by decoding the canonical PNG raster into nativeRaster.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: tiff
evidence: r/RCMetaR/tests/testthat/test-plot-devices.R: tiff::readTIFF independently verifies exported pixels, alpha compositing and publication resolution
direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Independent TIFF decoding verifies publication export pixels; the TIFF device writes LZW-compressed output at the requested resolution.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: methods

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: boot

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: stats

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: RCMetaR relies on standard R statistical functions that are distributed with R.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: utils
